subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved by documenting the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding contract?
rationale: Current main partially satisfies inline newline insertion through pi-tui, but configurable send behavior would create a new public TUI config or CLI surface under the repository's high config-surface bar.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update the TUI guide and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved TUI config or CLI bridge for Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter preferences with compatibility tests.

options.title: Narrow Or Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat pi-tui newline support as sufficient and explicitly mark docs/help and configurable keybindings out of scope or separately tracked.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update the TUI guide and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-history owner for the TUI docs/help/editor surface and prior review direction on this issue.
